title: Bai Xuan and the Supreme Lords
summary: Bai Dong finds Mu Chen again and sends Elder Qiu after him, so Mu Chen sends An Ran to find Su Xuan while he stalls. At middle-phase Heavenly Fusion he holds off Elder Qiu's Demon Dragon arts, then strikes at Bai Dong to force out a hidden expert: Bai Xuan, governor of White Dragon City, at middle-phase Heavenly Transformation. Su Xuan's team arrives in time, exposes Bai Xuan as a member of the Dragon Demon Palace, and he vows to kill Mu Chen once he has the sacred object. The factions combine to break the White Dragon Sovereign's barrier, and a residual image of the White Dragon Sovereign appears and shrugs off their attacks. Bai Xuan calls him a traitor to the Dragon Demon Palace and summons a doppelganger of the Black Dragon Sovereign.
events: An Ran goes for help while Mu Chen stalls Elder Qiu
Mu Chen blocks Elder Qiu and hits Bai Dong to draw out a hidden expert
Su Xuan's team arrives and names Bai Xuan a Dragon Demon Palace man
Everyone attacks the White Dragon Sovereign's barrier
The White Dragon Sovereign's residual image appears
Bai Xuan summons the Black Dragon Sovereign's doppelganger
introduced: Black Dragon Sovereign (as 'Black Dragon Supreme Lord')
cultivation: Mu Chen: Heavenly Fusion, Middle Phase. Elder Qiu: Heavenly Transformation, Initial Phase. Bai Xuan: Heavenly Transformation, Middle Phase (as he shows it; he reveals more in EP49). Su Xuan: Heavenly Transformation, Middle Phase.
